name: Johnson Furniture Company
old_description: Johnson Furniture has been serving the River Region for more than 60 years and is proud to be furnishing the homes of the fifth generation of many of our loyal customers. We take pride in selling quality name brand furniture at tremendous savings with FREE delivery.
about:
Johnson Furniture Company operates showrooms in Eclectic and Greenville, Alabama, serving the River Region for over six decades. The company does not disclose a founding year or founder names, and ownership details are not publicly stated.

The retailer stocks and sells furniture from more than a dozen name-brand manufacturers, including Ashley Furniture, Best Home Furnishings, Bradington Young, and Kincaid. Its two locations provide in-stock merchandise and special-order services, supported by an interior design staff that assists customers with fabric and style selections. Free delivery is offered on all purchases.

The business serves residential customers seeking home furnishings across traditional, transitional, rustic, and contemporary styles. Its customer base includes multi-generational families in the River Region, with the company noting it has furnished homes for fifth-generation clients.

Johnson Furniture emphasizes value pricing on branded goods, free delivery, and personalized design assistance as its primary differentiators. The company was founded to help customers complete the look they envision for their homes, according to its website.
